text.formatted: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
text.plain: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

text.formatted: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
text.plain: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.
text.plain: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +10, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

text.formatted: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
text.plain: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

text.formatted: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. _Failure:_ 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. _Success:_ The target is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.
text.plain: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. Success: The target is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

text.formatted: _Trigger:_ Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. _Response:_ The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.
text.plain: Trigger: Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. Response: The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.
